reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: peerPingerHeartbeat (lines 2211-2236) uses fixed 30-minute MetadataRequestFrequency timer with no fork-aware acceleration. The 01e specification (outputs/01e_PARTIAL_MANUAL_15_109_190_216.json, lines 36-49) requires that 'all peer metadata fields that are semantically redefined by the new protocol version (e.g., custody_group_count becoming meaningful at Fulu) must be refreshed from each connected peer within a bounded time' and 'stale pre-transition default values (e.g., zero) must not be used for post-transition decisions.' The code violates this by allowing up to 30 minutes before refreshing. When updateMetadataV2ToV3 (line 2170-2178) converts pre-Fulu altair.MetaData to fulu.MetaData, it omits custody_group_count, which defaults to 0 (uint64 default). The matchIntersection filter (line 374-384) uses this stale zero value in resolve_columns_from_custody_groups, causing zero overlap and blocking data column sync network-wide during the critical fork transition window. The spec violation is clear and the attack scenario is plausible. Severity remains Medium per the contest scope (this affects data availability sampling, a Fusaka-specific feature).
